data.one_liner: Create BDD tests in Dart code with readable error messages and Gherkin feature file export.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to write Behavior-Driven Development tests directly in Dart code without requiring build_runner or separate glue files. It automatically exports Gherkin feature files when tests run and provides clear console error messages.
use_when: You want to write BDD tests directly in code without managing separate feature and glue files.
You need to automatically export Gherkin/Cucumber feature files from your test suite.
avoid_when: You require traditional BDD setups where business analysts author strict feature files first and developers write glue code.
strengths: Does not require code generation or build_runner.
Eliminates the need for glue files by implementing BDD directly in typed Dart code.
Automatically exports valid Gherkin/Cucumber feature files upon test runs.
weaknesses: Requires developers to handle the translation of business requirements directly into code.
Not suited for teams that strictly enforce business analysts writing `.feature` files first.
data.setup_notes: Add to dev_dependencies and write BDD test blocks directly using the framework API.
